name: Midnight Lies
source:
One moment you're behind the wheel. The next, you're being dragged from the wreck by a stranger… who may be more dangerous than the crash itself.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
前一刻，你還坐在方向盤後面。下一刻，就有個陌生人把你從車禍殘骸裡拖出來……而這個人，也許比車禍本身更加危險。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
